description: This PHP source file defines the AccessAnalyzerClient class for the AWS SDK, providing methods to interact with the AWS Access Analyzer service. It includes method annotations for various service operations and extends the AwsClient base class.

classes.name: AccessAnalyzerClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Access Analyzer service, with methods for managing and retrieving access analysis data.

methods.name: applyArchiveRule
methods.description: Method to apply an archive rule in the Access Analyzer service.

methods.name: checkAccessNotGranted
methods.description: Checks resources for access that has not been granted.

methods.name: checkNoNewAccess
methods.description: Verifies that no new access has been granted.

methods.name: checkNoPublicAccess
methods.description: Checks for resources with public access.

methods.name: getAccessPreview
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific access preview.

methods.name: getAnalyzedResource
methods.description: Gets details of an analyzed resource.

methods.name: getAnalyzer
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific analyzer.

methods.name: getArchiveRule
methods.description: Retrieves details of an archive rule.

methods.name: getFinding
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific finding.

methods.name: getFindingRecommendation
methods.description: Gets recommendations related to a specific finding.

methods.name: getFindingV2
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a finding version 2.

methods.name: listAccessPreviewFindings
methods.description: Lists findings in an access preview.

methods.name: listAnalyzedResources
methods.description: Lists resources analyzed by the service.
